test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Awareness (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Kishor Makwana's appointment as Chairman of NCSC is significant in which evaluative context?

options.text: Social justice administration and SC policy implementation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Social justice administration and SC policy implementation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kishor Makwana** has been appointed as the **Chairman of the National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC)**, which plays a pivotal role in ensuring the effective implementation of policies and programs for the upliftment of Scheduled Castes (SC).
 
• The significance of this appointment lies in the **context of social justice administration**, as the NCSC is responsible for safeguarding the interests of the SC community under **Article 338 of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• The Commission monitors and evaluates the implementation of various government schemes and legislations aimed at promoting **equality, social justice, and empowerment** of the SC population.
 
• By taking leadership of the NCSC, Kishor Makwana's appointment underscores a focus on improving the effectiveness of **policy implementation** and addressing the systemic challenges faced by the SC community, such as **discrimination, untouchability, and lack of access to resources.**
 
• The role of the NCSC also includes advising the government on matters related to **social justice**, such as educational and economic development initiatives for SC individuals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Agricultural economic reforms**__

 __
 
• This option refers to reforms aimed at improving **agricultural productivity, income levels, and rural economy**. It is unrelated to the work of the NCSC, as the Commission does not focus on agriculture-specific issues.
 
 
 
• **Political consolidation in Southern India**__
 __
 
• This option pertains to the **political strategies and alliances** formed in Southern states of India. It is not relevant to the functioning or objectives of the NCSC, which operates at the national level.
 
 
 
• **Caste census leadership**__
 
 
• The caste census involves collecting data related to **caste demographics** in India. While caste data can influence NCSC policies, the Commission itself does not directly lead census efforts.
